description:
The National Ground Intelligence Center (NGIC) seeks information from qualified sources capable of satisfying the government’s Rivanna Station Facilities Maintenance Services (RSFMS) maintenance support requirements. This sources sought notice is a means of conducting market research to identify interested parties with the capability to support the government’s requirements. 

 Please see the attached documents.
